messages:
mike: Heads-up: invoice preview for tenant T-847 shows ~-120 credits for the 03/14 window. Looks like routing tag arrived late and got tallied in the next window. Anyone else seeing negative deltas?
tara: Yep I see it on the preview dashboard, looks like events from edge shard 12 arrived after the watermark. Possible retry storm at ~03:12.
eli: Do we know if it's duplicate events or late-arrival? If it's late-arrival we should backfill; dedupe won't help. I can pull the raw events. Quick query I'm running: SELECT * FROM metering.events WHERE tenant='T-847' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-03-14T03:00:00Z' AND '2025-03-14T04:00:00Z'
jess: FWIW alerting flagged a spike in `unattributed_tokens` at 03:12. The dashboard didn't surface shard id. We should add shard and route_tag to that metric label.
mike: I tailed the consumer logs. Pattern: same request_id repeated but with different route_tag header states. Looks like proxy retries with header strip on failover — created duplicate tokens that landed in two adjacent windows.
tara: Oh — header strip on failover -> events appear as different routes -> double-count across windows. We should normalize on ingest to prefer request_id when present, or canonicalize route_tag.
eli: Propose short term: deploy a canary dedupe in the ingest consumer that uses (tenant, request_id) + small TTL (1h) to suppress obvious duplicates and emit a "dedupe_hit" metric. Long term: fix proxy to preserve route_tag on retries.
jess: :thumbsup: Agree on canary. Console UX note: invoice preview should expose flags per line like `is_late` and `deduped` so customers/PMs don't panic when totals wobble.
oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-3421 - metering-duplicate-events. Assigned to @eli.
mike: I'll open a tiny PR to the ingest lambda with dedupe behind a feature-flag + metric probes (dedupe_hits, dup_latency). ETA EOD. Will post link for review + canary runbook.
tara: I'll add a dashboard card showing late-arrival rate by shard + request_id collision rate. Also adding an alert: invoice_preview negative_total > $1 -> pager to eng-platform oncall.
jess: SG. If folks need test data for replays use tenant `T-847-staging`.
eli: I'll attach the raw event sample to INC-3421. Quick snippet I used to extract examples from edge logs: ```curl -s 'https://logs.internal/edge/shard/12?from=2025-03-14T03:00:00Z' | jq '.events[] | {req_id:.req_id, route_tag:.headers.route_tag, ts:.ts}'```
mike: Thanks — that snippet helps. We'll track the canary and dashboard changes in INC-3421 and loop in the proxy team tomorrow morning. Good catch everyone.
